Supabase Data Connection

Multi-Strategy Live Sync Engine:

• Automatically fetches via Google Visualization JSONP (works even from local file:// without CORS errors), Direct CSV, and CORS Proxy Fallbacks.

• Verifies tab headers before applying data so Google Sheets never silently falls back to the Faculty tab when loading Semester Calendar.

• Make sure your Google Sheet sharing is set to "Anyone with the link → Viewer".

Uploading an .xlsx file updates all 7 tabs at once and caches them in your browser.

Create Sub-Admin

Creates a Supabase Auth account and assigns its role in public.user_roles.

Minimum 8 characters. The password is sent securely to the Edge Function and is never saved in the dashboard.

Database record created
user_id = new Auth user UUID
role = sub_admin
display_name = entered full name
created_at = database timestamp
